about_the_game:
Step into a moment of stillness.
This is not a challenge, nor a story — only a fleeting meditation. For a few minutes, you sit at the edge of quiet places, dipping your feet into the water. The ripples spread, light shimmers, and soft sounds drift around you.

There is no goal to reach, no score to chase — just the simple rhythm of water and breath.
A pause, a fragment of calm, waiting to be revisited whenever you need it.

Features

  • Gentle 5-minute experience of visual and sound meditation.

  • Different ambient locations, each with its own quiet mood.

  • Relaxing ASMR soundscape for headphones.

  • A space to step away, unwind, and breathe.
